pairs.rule_a_desc: Adopting a new domain track (mobile, ML, blockchain, IoT) — gates import on demand, ownership, CI fit, Sunset compat BEFORE harvest
pairs.rule_b_desc: Creating/editing/reviewing skills — minimum quality standard; every skill executable, validated, self-contained

pairs.rule_a_desc: Running verbose CLI output — git, tests, linters, docker, build tools, artisan, npm, composer. Wrap with rtk; tail/grep fallback
pairs.rule_b_desc: Running PHP inside Docker — artisan, composer, phpstan, rector, ecs, phpunit, tests, migrations, any CLI tool

pairs.rule_a_desc: Editing .augment/ or .agent-src.uncondensed/ — keep files project-agnostic; sync counts and cross-refs on add/rename/delete
pairs.rule_b_desc: Editing files in .agent-src/ or .augment/ — source of truth is .agent-src.uncondensed/; never edit generated dirs directly

pairs.rule_a_desc: Git commit format, branch naming, conventional commits, committing, pushing, creating PRs
pairs.rule_b_desc: Git history ops — never rebase/squash/amend without explicit request; once pushed, rewrites must pair with immediate re-push same turn

pairs.rule_a_desc: Generating PR/issue/comment/commit bodies — forbids 'Generated with', 'Co-authored by', 'Pull Request opened by' attribution footers
pairs.rule_b_desc: Generating PR/issue/commit titles or PR/issue comments — forbids decorative emojis; allowed in PR/issue descriptions + commit bodies only when matched by an in-artifact legend

pairs.rule_a_desc: Authoring or executing roadmaps — forbid task ci / make test / npm run check steps when quality.local_auto_run is false; skip inline
pairs.rule_b_desc: Any roadmap touch (file move, checkbox flip, phase change) regens dashboard same response; archive at 0 open

pairs.rule_a_desc: Creating a new skill/rule/command/guideline or significantly rewriting one — runs mandatory Understand → Research → Draft first
pairs.rule_b_desc: After creating or improving a skill/rule/guideline/command — ask if it should be contributed upstream to the shared package
